title: Nuplex Industries (Aust) Pty Ltd - proposed acquisition of the resins manufacturing and composite resale business of Huntsman Chemical Company Australia Pty Ltd
targets: Huntsman Chemical Company Australia Pty Ltd

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines. Market inquiries commenced
Closing date for submissions from interested parties
ACCC decided not to oppose the acquisition

body_sections.Summary: Nuplex proposes to acquire the resins manufacturing and composites resale business of Huntsman.
body_sections.Market definition: For the purpose of this assessment the ACCC considered the following narrow markets: - the national market for the manufacture and supply of unsaturated polyester resins; - the national market for the manufacture and supply of vinyl ester resins; and - the national market for the manufacture and supply of gelcoats and flowcoats. The competition assessment in this instance would not change even if a broader product market was adopted.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC decided not to oppose the proposed acquisition on the basis that imports would be likely to constrain the merged firm.
